overview: The Medford City Council requested draft regulations on commercial firearm storage, asked the administration to address online tax payment convenience fees, and heard resident concerns regarding National Grid gas main construction on Harvard Street. The Council also referred a proposed store price-accuracy ordinance to committee and passed several local infrastructure requests.

items.title: Commercial Firearm Storage Safety Ordinance Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a draft ordinance regulating the commercial display and storage of firearms, ammunition, and accessories in Medford.

items.title: Online Tax Payment Convenience Fees
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the administration eliminate or assume online tax payment convenience fees and provide an in-person explanation to the Council.

items.title: Local Infrastructure Resolutions
items.summary: Approved individual resolutions to replace a sidewalk on Warren Street, place an electronic speed sign on High Street, and replace a street pole on Mangoun Avenue.

items.title: Harvard Street National Grid Gas Main Work
items.summary: Heard resident concerns regarding traffic and sleep disruptions from National Grid gas main work on Harvard Street, approving motions requesting a clerk of the works, a traffic plan, abutter notifications, and project mitigation.

items.title: Consumer Protection Ordinance on Price Accuracy
items.summary: Referred a draft ordinance to the Subcommittee on Business and Economic Development that would require stores to credit or refund customers when items are incorrectly price-marked.

items.title: Unfinished Business and Meeting Records
items.summary: Placed a tabled common victualler license on file and tabled previous meeting records.
